title: Pre-medical studies abandoned
summary: He studied pre-med at Pasadena as a second interest but gave up the idea after a hospital visit convinced him he could never operate.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I read in one of the biographical sketches that at Pasadena College you were studying pre-med.
Yes, I later became interested in
medicine, but it didn't supercede music. It was a second -- my second liking, preference -- or my preference.
Was it your intention at that time possibly to become a doctor, or was it just you were studying because you were interested in the subject?

I was interested in the subject, and there was a faint desire that maybe someday I would like to become a doctor, and I took this along through school, the physiologies, the chemistries and different things like that, and the thing that sort of discouraged me was when I made a trip to a hospital -- the class went to the hospital -- and seeing the different things in the hospital and the people and sick and different things like that, I soon realized that I could never operate. Also we must remember that in those days there wasn't much specializing to the extent that it is now in medicine, and therefore you had to be more or less a general practitioner. And so I just put the idea of medicine out of my mind, because I was quite sure that I could -- if I'd lose one patient, I'd be through with medicine anyway, so -- forget it.
